subject.title: fix: discord exec approvals fails against local self-signed TLS gateway

question: Should maintainers repair and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/80204, replace it with a clean equivalent shared-bootstrap fix, or hold for broader Gateway TLS trust-policy review?
rationale: The issue affects certificate trust decisions for approval/bootstrap clients, and the active fix is both security-sensitive and currently conflicting, so automation should not open another repair without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair active PR
options.body: Fix the stale import and merge conflicts in the active shared-bootstrap PR, then rerun focused Gateway, ACP, MCP, and approval validation.

options.title: Replace with clean PR
options.body: Close or supersede the active branch with a narrow equivalent fix that preserves the same TLS target-selection semantics.

options.title: Hold for TLS policy review
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers revisit local, remote, CLI, and env TLS pin precedence as a broader trust-policy decision.

recommendation.title: Repair active PR
recommendation.body: Fix the stale import and merge conflicts in the active shared-bootstrap PR, then rerun focused Gateway, ACP, MCP, and approval validation.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest feature-history trail for shared Gateway approval/bootstrap and TLS trust-boundary decisions.
